purpose: Read-only concordance between Ad Fontes - Volume One and the approved Ordinary Means comparison commentary in Ad Fontes NT
countingRule: A case group is a textual locus or tightly related set of loci that receives either a headed treatment or repeated substantive use in the book. Mark 9:44/46 and Acts 15:20/29 are each one case group; the two distinct Romans 16 problems are separate groups.

epub.role: systematic text extraction and heading inventory

caseGroups.currentEvidence: BSB, BLB and N1904 omit the closing clause; MSB, YLT, RP2018 and TR-BOYD include it; BSB and MSB carry reciprocal publisher notes.
BSB, BLB and N1904 preserve the shorter form; MSB, YLT, RP2018 and TR-BOYD contain Matthean expansions; BSB and MSB identify the differences in publisher notes.
BSB, BLB and N1904 read Isaiah the prophet; MSB, YLT, RP2018 and TR-BOYD read the prophets; BSB and MSB provide reciprocal notes.
BSB, BLB, YLT, N1904 and TR-BOYD read church of God; MSB and RP2018 read church of the Lord and God; BSB and MSB also preserve publisher-note alternatives.
All seven displayed editions print the prayer. BSB and MSB note that some manuscripts omit it, so the omission can only be represented as a publisher-note alternative in the current corpus.
BSB, BLB and N1904 omit without cause; MSB, YLT, RP2018 and TR-BOYD include it; BSB and MSB provide reciprocal notes.
All seven displayed editions preserve the standard reading and none supplies the book's Codex Bezae/Old Latin expansion as a publisher note. A reviewed Western-text source is required.
The current corpus exposes a smaller Tyrannus/a certain Tyrannus difference, but not the Western fifth-hour-to-tenth-hour expansion treated by the book. A reviewed Western-text source is required.
All seven displayed editions preserve the fourfold decree and none supplies the book's Western ethical form as a publisher note. A reviewed Western-text source is required.
All seven displayed editions read gentle. BSB and MSB note the young children reading associated with WH/NA, so that reading is available only through publisher notes in the current corpus.
BSB and BLB read Jesus; MSB, YLT, N1904, RP2018 and TR-BOYD read Lord; BSB and MSB document the split in publisher notes.

caseGroups.bookLocator: chapters 12 and 14, especially printed pages 329 and 401-402
caseGroups.currentEvidence: BLB reads will not be found, N1904 reads will be found, MSB/YLT/RP2018/TR-BOYD read burned up, and BSB prints laid bare with a publisher note identifying the alternatives.
